blurb: Due to sparse food, dungeon life isn't easy
for rats. However, sometimes a large food
source will cause a boom in the population.
In such times, a very smart rat
emerges as the king.
ARTEMISIA uses her
ghostly abilities to be an even more
wily hunter.
A construct devised by the Magicians' Guild,
magic and technology have given the
AUTOMATON the gift of life.
Fathered by wrath, this dark spirit
seeks those with ambitious purpose.
Wild blood-sucking bats recently
infested the Hamlet mines.
Though small, wild flapping makes BATS
a hard target for even the most skilled
adventurers. Expect more than half of
attacks to miss these dungeon pests!
The enigmatic master of the Hunters' Guild,
BRAM KINDLY is said to have disappeared
while investigating the surge of undead.
Beings of immense power tend to attract
followers. Verona, Aleera & Marishka
pledged themselves to a mighty vampire.
He gladly tutored them in vampiric magics
inside his grim castle.
Those who have survived BUBBLES claim that
she isn't a crab at all. Rather, she is
a demonic spirit taking a crab's shape.
BUGBEARS often use ruins for homes, and
recently set up camp underneath Hamlet.
A creature long thought to be extinct,
the COCKATRICE is a powerful flying beast.
Its razor sharp talons make quick work of
any prey it paralyzes with its breath.
Its feathers are thought to be magical.
Ghoul hunter CORAL GRIMES and his posse
rose to fame, but sextons warn that the
dead keep their compulsions from life.
Giant dungeon CRABS
are patient hunters.
Their slow metabolism and poison claws
make them well suited to waiting for prey
to ambush, and devour.
The bigger brother of the automaton,
the CRYSTAL GOLEM has emerged from
an excess of magic material and will.
When it raises its arms, it's
best to be somewhere else.
Said to be a manifestation of primal
violence, DEMONS are found near
the greatest sources of evil.
As foul as demons are, those who climb the
demonic ranks are fouler still.
The devil BAPHOMET commands the
surrounding hells to his will, using
minions, magic, and brimstone.
He will not permit interlopers
to quell his ambitions.
The DUMMYBOT is extraordinarily durable.
With proper maintenance, your shielded
companion(s) can serve as a powerful
guardian while you attend to business!
Those ENSLAVED at death possess a
supernatural hunger.
With fine gear and a stern demeanor,
he earned himself an ironic nickname.
Rarely a goatman lives long enough for its
fur to turn silver, and only somewhat less
rarely, one is born naturally that way.
With persistence, ambient necromancy may
cause a body to rematerialize.
GHOULS attack when their rest is disturbed.
GNOMES are known for their mischief.
One must take care when seeking to
plunder a gnome's food and riches.
When gold-addicted gnomes have none
to mine, they organize to hunt for it.
Beware of GNOME THIEF ambushing parties
who use traps and weapons with deadly
skill.
A tribal people from neighboring
mountains, GOATMEN are hardy,
dull-witted folk.
Their culture revolves around drink,
though they can be competent in
many skills when satiated.
While highly resourceful, their minds have
detiriorated, rendering many of them
dependent on raids against humans.
While the airborne GYROBOT can avoid
most threats, some dangers are
too large to out-maneuver.
Curious GYROBOTS may unintentionally
trigger traps and cease function.
Hamlet commoners once hailed
from many nations to trade
and work together peaceably.
With proper focus, HUMANS can become
adept in whatever they set their minds to.
Terrible mischief makers, IMPS wander
wherever they can inflict suffering.
Their wings and magical ability allow them
to devastate foes, often well out of reach,
cackling all the while.
He uses spells and weapons to toy with his
victims, though some take a direct approach
in their quest for evil.
Not much is known about the elusive bug
people who roam in remote places.
Their skill and mysterious physiology give
them an edge on the battlefield, striking
fear into many humans.
The KOBOLDS are small, scaly folk.
They have long been a problem for the
Magicians' Guild, thanks to their innate
magic resistance.
BARON HERX's body is blackened in the
death of his flesh, but wields immense
magical power and a dark bond with Hell.
Those going toe-to-toe with him must be
well prepared for his spells.
ORPHEUS uses his passion to fuel his magic
and likes to dominate his problems
face-to-face.
ERUDYCE prefers the right spell,
placed with severe intent, to turn
events in her favor.
A name first given in myth to the primal
succubus, those who lead and inspire
succubi are sometimes granted this title.
Beware her influence, as her foes
are known to switch sides.
Little is understood of a MIMIC'S true
nature, but it's assumed they didn't
always look like treasure chests.
Further study has been impossible due to
them eating researchers and their notes.
A huge legendary beast of unknown origin,
the MINOTAUR can break through dungeon
walls and has been enchanted, permitting it
to levitate.
It is ruthless in its pursuit of its master's
enemies.
This MYSTERIOUS MERCHANT knows things
he couldn't possibly know and carries
artifacts he couldn't possibly possess.
He will trade only if given mystical orbs,
if the customer can bear to offer them.
In contrast to his kin, THE POTATO KING
appears merry and carefree.
Fellow goblins seem drawn to his chaotic
personality, perhaps desperate for levity
in the swamps.
While one would be wise to stay wary of
swarms and sneaky RATS, usually the sight
of them means the promise of food.
The hardy SCARAB is said to bore into dense,
magical materials, conveying profound
magical resistance into their shells.
A good shield in skilled hands can block the
deadly paralyzing sting of the SCORPION.
Often assumed to be a modern invention,
variants of this SENTRYBOT blueprint have
been found active among ancient ruins.
Though easily broken, tinkerers rely
on sentrybots for high damage output.
An evil spirit that wanders, appearing not
to have any sense of itself.
Those who have survived SHELOB claim that
she isn't a spider at all. Rather, she is
a demonic spirit taking a spider's shape.
Good SHOPKEEPERS somehow make their
businesses work anywhere.
They are picky about what they buy.
Word travels fast in the Merchants' Guild.
One must take care both when fighting and
looting them, as the battered gear may
harm more than it helps.
The exoskeleton of this beast bears
innumerable splits and scratches from
battling with weaker prey.
Naturalists claim that scorpions like
SKRABBLAG are capable of aging into
immortality.
Found in a variety of colors, SLIMES are
entities seeking endless
consumption.
They often find themselves sliding through
pipes or waterways in their search for
organic matter to liquefy.
All automated tinkering mechanisms rely
on magic scrap for limited behaviors.
The SPELLBOT is affixed with a large supply
allowing it to create magic damage.
Giant dungeon SPIDERS
are patient hunters.
A personified curse of lust, the SUCCUBUS
is crafty and cruel.
The amiability between trolls and gnomes is
well-documented, but typically the gnomes
enjoy toying with the bigger beasts.
THUMPUS appears to have
earned the gnomes' respect.
These nearly blind giants seem to be
wandering the dungeons by coincidence,
preferring to live in isolation, even from
one another.
In order to maintain their curse of
immortality, VAMPIRES must consume the
blood of the living.
They have wonderous magical abilities,
which are said to be gained by forfeiting
their very souls.
The cult of sorcerers believes that all
intellect is born of magic, claiming that
where you find one, the other will follow.
GREMLINS are creatures with such taste
for chaos that they could not coexist
with the denizens of Hell itself.
Only goblins suffer their company,
and even then, at arm's length.
While the origins are unclear, a forest
of sufficient size and age is often under
the protection of DRYAD conservators.
Sightings in any realm are rare, but it
is best to remain in their good
graces if one finds you.
Wherever you find decay in dryad-
protected forests, there you will also
find MYCONIDS. While the two aren't
hostile to one another, they also do
not appear to cohabitate. Beware caves
full of mushrooms that may be guarded.
Legends say that SALAMANDERS carry the
fires of loyalty and justice with fierce
devotion to the Eternals in their hearts.
When enraged, they appear as blazing
angels, but rely on sturdy tradition
A product of dark mysticism, the
REVENANT SKULL is summoned by piercing
void just as a cursed soul crosses over.
Whether through naivety or mischief,
FIRE SPRITES like to bless others with
a gift of burning flames. Novice
sorcerers can learn a lot from them, as
their temprament is the calmest of the
fire spirits.
The EARTH SPRITE requires the
talents of a skilled mystic to conjure.
After being lured into local earth, it
crashes down and serves as a
durable guardian for as long
as its form holds shape.
Like many birds, DUCKS are territorial,
and loyal to their partners for life.
They will courageously pester deadly
threats, and are surprisingly deft at
avoiding harm. Ducks may become
distracted by fishing opportunities.
